welcome.text: Welcome to Palette Room. Let's design this room together, one piece at a time. A glowing arrow will point at what to use next. You can go back or skip the tour at any time.

pinch.text: Point and pinch. Hold up a hand, palm facing away, and a ray comes out of it. Point the ray at a button and pinch your thumb and index finger together to press it. With controllers, point and pull the trigger. Point at Next and pinch.

dock.text: Your Palettes panel. Everything starts from this panel. Panels stay where you put them in your room, and each one has a bar underneath, like a window's title bar. Pinch the bar under the Palettes panel, move it somewhere comfortable, and let go.

open-shop.text: Open the shopping list. The shopping list has every piece of furniture, in real-world sizes. Let's furnish the room one piece at a time. Press Shopping list.

add-sofa.text: Start with a sofa. Big pieces come first. The sofa takes the room's main color. Each plus places a piece in front of you. Press plus on the sofa.

add-rug.text: Ground it with a rug. A rug ties the seating together and carries the main color across the floor. Press plus on the rug.

add-table.text: Add a coffee table. Supporting pieces like tables and shelves take the second color, about a third of the room. Press plus on the coffee table.

add-radio.text: Turn on some music. Small accents bring the last touch of color. This radio plays the music: wherever you put it, that's where the sound comes from. Press plus on the radio.

close-shop.text: Close the list. That's a good start. You can come back for more pieces any time. Press Close.

move.text: Move the sofa. Every piece can be picked up and put somewhere new. Point at it and pinch from a distance, or grab it up close. Pieces glow red where they won't fit. Pinch the sofa, drag it to a new spot, and let go.

color-piece.text: Color one piece. A quick pinch and release on a piece, without moving it, opens its colors. Choose which palette color each part uses, like the cushions or the legs. Quick-pinch the sofa.

palette.text: Try a palette. Each card is a five color palette. The room follows the sixty thirty ten rule: about sixty percent main color, thirty percent supporting color, and ten percent accent. Pinch a palette card, and watch the color sweep across the room.

wheel.text: Make your own palette. The color wheel turns a color you love into a full palette, using color harmonies. Find it here whenever you're ready.

briefs.text: Design briefs. Want a challenge? Design briefs give you a goal to design to. Meet a brief to earn up to three stars.

lookbook.text: Your lookbook. Save snapshots of your rooms in the lookbook, lay a saved room out again, or send its shopping list to your phone.

settings.text: Settings. Music, sound effect and voice volumes, the language, the main menu and Quit are all in Settings. Lost this panel? Press the menu button on a controller to bring it back.

done.text: You're all set. Your room is saved on the headset, so you can carry on next time. Take the tour again from Tutorial in the Palettes panel. Have fun!
